correctness.rationale: Every S/2=O_m has forced even part, a least odd b>=m, a forced odd tail beginning b+2m, and freely selectable m-1 intermediate odd positions. Closure proves converse, and any relative expression of one intermediate odd needs itself because any positive even increment is >=2m and any three odd summands are >=3b>=b+2m. Thus r=1+|B| exactly. Gap counting gives g=g_0+m-r+h, h=(b-b_0)/2>=0. Enumerating size-(r-1) subsets yields coefficients binom(m-1,r-1), generating series z^g0 w(z+w)^(m-1)/(1-z), and sharp plateau. Proof explicitly treats all integers m>=2 and all genera. Independent dynamic-closure program checked 2794 parameter cases and 216 bounded brute masks, but finite tests do not prove infinity.
